summary: Full-stack testing of Lebo MVP. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (auth, ownership isolation user-A vs user-B on contacts/incidents/events, contacts CRUD+reorder+invitations, emergency activate/active/acknowledge/cancel, safety timers + check-ins, journeys, modes activate, location shares w/ invalid contact 404, incidents soft-delete, safety plan upsert, support directory filter/search/distance sort, chatbot Claude Sonnet 4.6 reply persisted, app-lock enable+verify with wrong PIN 401, account export, delete revokes session). Frontend (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844): login -> home dashboard renders (status card, slider, I'M SAFE, quick actions), tabs Safety/Find Help/Journal/Profile/Home all navigable, Find Help shows all 14 seeded SA organisations with Call/Directions actions, Contacts screen add-flow adds contact successfully, Safety Timer screen renders interval + grace period selectors, Ask Lebo chat returns rich Claude Sonnet 4.6 reply (safety plan guidance), Incident New page renders category chips + form, Settings shows app lock + privacy + export/delete options. No red screens, no crashes.
action_items: No blocking issues found. Optional polish: initial 401 console error appears on preview root before user has token (expected but noisy) — consider suppressing/handling axios 401 silently before login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~970 lines — still readable due to clear section comments; could be split into modules (auth, emergency, support, chat) if it grows further.

public_event() cancelledAt/notifications timestamps are formatted in-place, which mutates the DB doc dict returned from Motor. Currently harmless (fresh copy is made via dict(e)), but nested notifications list is not deep-copied — safe today because responses are serialized immediately, but be aware if any caller reuses the result.
activate_emergency does not set safetyStatus back on cancel_event when event is already cancelled (idempotency ok, returns 404 as expected).

Chat endpoint replays only 'user' history to Claude (assistant turns are not fed back) — this may lose context across long sessions; consider passing both roles to LlmChat if the SDK supports assistant messages.
argon2 verify raises other exceptions (InvalidHash) that are not caught — only VerifyMismatchError is. A corrupted hash would return 500 instead of 401. Low risk.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users with TEST_-prefixed data (contacts, incidents, modes, shares). One persistent 'Mom' contact was created for kat@test.com via UI to keep manual retest simple.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run: cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/backend_test.py -v (pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope). Use example.com domain for register — pydantic EmailStr rejects .local/.test TLDs. Test user kat@test.com/secret123 is onboarded already so login lands directly on home dashboard (no onboarding skip needed). Emergency slider on web preview navigates to /emergency; Find Help asks for location permission (Enable button); on web that is optional and orgs still list.
